nodes.name: Solvothermal WO2.72 growth
nodes.procedure: Sea urchin-like WO_{2.72} microspheres were grown on the TF surface (WO_{2.72}/TF) through a simple solvothermal reaction.
nodes.source_text: Sea urchin-like WO_{2.72} microspheres were grown on the TF surface (WO_{2.72}/TF) through a simple solvothermal reaction (Figures S1a and S2, Supporting Information).

nodes.name: Air annealing to WO3
nodes.procedure: The WO_{2.72}/TF was first annealed at 400°C in air to obtain WO3/TF.
nodes.source_text: the WO_{2.72}/TF was first annealed at 400°C in air to obtain WO3/TF (Figures S1b and S3, Supporting Information).

nodes.name: Ir impregnation and H2/Ar reduction
nodes.procedure: Ir species were introduced onto the WO_{2.72}/TF support using an impregnation method and then thermally reduced in H_2/Ar atmosphere to yield Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF.

nodes.name: Ir loading on WO3 with annealing
nodes.procedure: To synthesize Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF and Ir/WO3/TF, the WO_{2.72}/TF was first annealed at 400°C in air to obtain WO3/TF. The annealing temperature was then adjusted during the process of loading Ir on WO3/TF.
nodes.source_text: To synthesize Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF and Ir/WO3/TF, the WO_{2.72}/TF was first annealed at 400°C in air to obtain WO3/TF... The annealing temperature was then adjusted during the process of loading Ir on WO3/TF.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms monoclinic W_{18}O_{49} structure for Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF with (010) and (020) peaks at 23.4° and 47.7°; no Ir peaks detected due to low loading.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XRD pattern of WO_{2.72}/TF showed that all the characteristic peaks matched well with those of WO_{2.72} powder ... The two intense diffraction peaks located at 23.4° and 47.7° corresponded to the (010) and (020) reflections of the monoclinic W_{18}O_{49} structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman bands at 263, 325, 712, and 802 cm^{-1} assigned to O-W-O bending and W-O stretching vibrations; Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF shows broader/weaker peaks indicating oxygen deficiency disorder.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 2b, the Raman bands at 263 and 325 cm^{-1} were assigned to the bending vibration of O-W-O ... Notably, the characteristic peaks of the Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF were broader and weaker than those of Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF and Ir/WO_3/TF.

nodes.characterization_summary: EPR shows increasing oxygen deficiency degree: Ir/WO_3/TF < Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF < Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF as W:O ratios increase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 2c, the degree of oxygen deficiency in Ir/WO_3/TF, Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF, and Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF displayed an increasing trend as the ratios of W to O in the WO_x supports increased.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir loading on WO_x/TF is ≈0.04 mg cm^{-2}.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry analysis showed that the Ir loading on the WO_x/TF was ≈0.04 mg cm^{-2}.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution XPS: O 1s oxygen vacancy proportions 36.3% (Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF), 25.9% (Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF), 19.7% (Ir/WO_3/TF); W 4f shows W^{6+} at 36.1/38.3 eV, W^{5+} at 35.6/37.8 eV; Ir 4f majority metallic Ir^0 with enhanced Ir^{δ+} on WO_{2.72}.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution O 1s spectra of Ir/WO_x/TF could be deconvoluted into three component peaks centered at 530.6, 531.4, and 532.5 eV ... The proportion of O_v in the total O was estimated to be ≈36.3%, 25.9%, and 19.7% for Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF, Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF, and Ir/WO_3/TF, respectively.

properties.description: W 4f XPS spectra on IrWOxFy supports

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir L_3-edge XANES shows Ir oxidation state between 0 and +4; W L_3-edge shows lower white-line intensity after Ir loading, confirming electron donation from Ir to W sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ir L_3-edge XANES spectrum of Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF ... confirming that the oxidation state of the Ir site was between 0 and +4.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM confirms Ir/WO_x/TF maintains sea urchin-like morphology of WO_x/TF support after Ir loading.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figures S8a-c, S9a,d,g, Ir/WO_x/TF with Ir loading still maintained the original sea urchin-like structure similar to WO_{2.72}/TF.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM particle size distributions: Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF (0.82±0.24 nm), Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF (1.48±0.66 nm), Ir/WO_3/TF (1.95±0.85 nm) with aggregation on WO_3 and WO_{2.9}.
nodes.evidence_snippet: particle size distribution statistics revealed that the Ir nanoclusters were ≈0.82±0.24 nm ... Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF, ... average size of 1.48±0.66 nm ... Ir/WO_3/TF showed ... ≈1.95±0.85 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM shows homogeneous Ir distribution on WO_{2.72} nanowires with 0.38 nm lattice spacing matching W_{18}O_{49} (010); 3D surface plots reveal partial Ir atoms enrooted into WO_x lattice.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As illustrated in Figure 3d, the HAADF-STEM image showed that the Ir nanoclusters with low crystallinity were homogeneously distributed across the entire WO_{2.72} nanowires ... Enlarged three-dimensional (3D) surface plots ... revealed that three samples exhibited intriguing interfacial configurations of Ir and WO_x.

nodes.characterization_summary: C_dl values: 30.5 mF cm^{-2} for Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF, 13.0 mF cm^{-2} for Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF, 9.8 mF cm^{-2} for Ir/WO_3/TF, indicating larger ECSA for higher oxygen deficiency.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As a result, the C_dl of Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF was 30.5 mF cm^{-2}, which was higher than those of Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF (13.0 mF cm^{-2}) and Ir/WO_3/TF (9.8 mF cm^{-2}).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows charge transfer resistance R_ct: 7.1 Ω for Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF, 8.3 Ω for Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF, 9.7 Ω for Ir/WO_3/TF, 18.7 Ω for IrO_2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The equivalent electrical circuit fitting indicated that Ir/WO_{2.72}/TF had a charge transfer resistance (R_ct) of 7.1 Ω, which was smaller than those of Ir/WO_{2.9}/TF (8.3 Ω), Ir/WO_3/TF (9.7 Ω), and commercial IrO_2 (18.7 Ω).

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows WO_{2.72} nanowires grow along (010) direction with 0.38 nm lattice spacing matching monoclinic W_{18}O_{49} (010) plane.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) demonstrated that these nanowires preferentially grew along the (010) direction ... The well-resolved lattice space of 0.38 nm matched well with the corresponding (010) plane of monoclinic W_{18}O_{49}.

nodes.characterization_summary: Elemental mapping confirms uniform distribution of W and O elements in WO_{2.72} nanowires; homogeneous Ir distribution on WO_{2.72} support.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The corresponding elemental mapping images confirmed the uniform distribution of the W and O elements ... HAADF-STEM and corresponding elemental mapping images demonstrated the homogeneous distribution of the Ir element on WO_{2.72} support.
